Callout.Name: Walker with a Broken Ankle
Callout.Message: Walker unable to continue, suspected broken ankle.
Callout.Advisory: Ridge path, no road access, weather closing in.

Script.Line: It has been like this for an hour. I have not moved an inch.
I heard it go. There is no way I am walking down on it.
How are you getting me off this hill? Do not say by stretcher, because that is a joke.

Callout.Patient: I heard it go. I am not walking down from here.

Lines.Approach: She is on the ridge path and there is no road up there. Take the kit you can carry.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
